messages:
alex_r: Quick sync — release v2.3.1 cutoff in ~6h. Last-minute console/docs changes now or hold until next cycle. Drop changelog bullets here and call out any SDK surface changes.
priya: @alex_r I have two doc PRs: #412 (changelog entry) and #415 (console screenshot update). Both are small, but #415 needs the new image uploaded to the CDN.
priya: Planning to squash + merge once CI is green. Can someone run SDK docs regen after merge so links to new console screenshots get picked up?
matt: FYI SDK docs regen currently fails on main in CI with this error in the swagger parser: `TypeError: Cannot read property 'schemas' of undefined` — looks like a missing component ref from the new telemetry API.
matt: I can patch the SDK-gen script shortly, but will need a quick CR.
jen: If the patch is small I can review within an hour. @matt drop a PR and @tim can we avoid a big branch cut?
tim: We should avoid branching if possible. Proposed plan: merge doc PRs -> trigger SDK regen -> run docs site canary -> do final version bump + changelog link update -> cut release branch. I can own the canary deploy at T-2h.
priya: Thanks — I'll hold the screenshots until @matt's fix is in.
matt: PR up: #419 — fixes missing ref and updates `scripts/regenerate_sdk.sh` to tolerate empty components. Patch is a few lines.
jen: Reviewing now. inline: lgtm except small nit on a log message.
jen: Approving — please squash and merge when ready. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: docs-ci-bot started build for branch `main` (triggered by merge).
docs-ci-bot: docs CI: running `npm run docs:build` + `scripts/regenerate_sdk.sh`
docs-ci-bot: docs CI: error was reproducible, running regen with fallback enabled...
docs-ci-bot: docs CI: regen completed, build starting.
priya: Merged #419 and #412. Screenshots uploaded to `cdn.redwood-inference/static/console/v2.3.1/`.
tim: Kicking off canary deploy in staging. Command: ```./scripts/deploy_docs.sh --env staging --canary --tag v2.3.1-canary```
deploy-bot: docs deploy started: staging canary (v2.3.1-canary) — job 7821. Output tail: ```[info] uploading static assets
[info] switched to canary routing for 10% traffic
[success] canary up (url: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/canary)```
olivia: Smoke run on staging canary: nav to console guide, screenshot loads, code samples render, SDK docs link points to updated telemetry section. Quick sanity: search for "telemetry" works. No broken anchors.
priya: Can someone update the changelog header with the release date and link to merged PRs? I'll add the blurb but want the header bump done after we cut the release tag.
amalex: (automated) — note: version-bump should be `v2.3.1` not `v2.3.0` per the backlog.
jen: I'll take the final version bump commit and tag after we merge everything. Plan: do bump + changelog commit, run `npm run docs:build` locally, then tag `v2.3.1` and push.
tim: Sounds good. I'll freeze any additional merges 30m before tag. Queue is small.
priya: tiny follow-up: console screenshot alt text needs one tweak (accessibility). I pushed a quick amend to #415 earlier — it's included.
olivia: Final smoke on staging canary passed. No blockers from QA.
deploy-bot: docs deploy: promoting canary to prod in 10m per `./scripts/deploy_docs.sh --promote --tag v2.3.1-canary`
jen: Tagging to-do list for tag step: 1) freeze merges 2) bump version + changelog commit 3) run `npm run docs:build` 4) tag `v2.3.1` 5) push tag + trigger release pipeline.
priya: All set from docs side. Thanks team.
alex_r: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene in thread if anything blocks during the final 2 hours. If you need me to hold the release for any doc regressions ping here.
